entries.requirement: Every assertive business statement you write or report (price, savings, demand, conversion, what customers said, results) must cite a fact from a system of record; if no fact exists, the claim stays absent and the reason for its absence is recorded.
entries.why: A structural check passes a fabricated claim because a false claim is well-formed; only an evidence gate looks at content.

origin.quote: **A claim about the world needs a fact. Absence stays absent.**

entries.requirement: Never let a modelled or projected figure fill a slot whose meaning is 'this was true': a projection, anchor price or forecast conversion rate is not an observed value, and only observed data may be reported as a result.
entries.why: A modelled anchor price presented as a former price is a false statement even when the model is sound.

origin.quote: - **Never let a recommendation become a fact.** A modelled anchor price is not a former
